project_info.theme: Warm luxury-car portrait with a playful finger-heart gesture
project_info.color_palette: deep chocolate brown, rich red, black, warm amber city light

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with olive skin, symmetrical natural facial features, deep brown eyes, defined eyelashes, warm terracotta eyeshadow, cocoa-brown lipstick, dimples, soft peach blush, a small nose stud, gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace. She wears a deep chocolate-brown jersey hijab and matching dark-brown ribbed long-sleeve knit top with black high-waisted denim jeans.

items: seated in a luxury vehicle at night
one eye closed in a playful wink
red quilted leather seat behind her
dark vehicle trim and blurred moving city lights through the window

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft warm cabin lighting with high-key facial illumination
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: cinematic gentle shadows and sharp focus on the subject with soft background bokeh

technical_specs.color_treatment: vibrant but realistic browns and reds, natural skin texture, controlled cinematic contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a high-resolution cinematic portrait of an adult woman seated inside a luxury vehicle at night. She has olive skin, deep brown eyes, defined eyelashes, warm terracotta eyeshadow, matte cocoa-brown lipstick, prominent dimples, soft peach blush, a small nose stud, gold hoop earrings, and a delicate gold necklace. She wears a deep chocolate-brown jersey hijab elegantly wrapped around her head and neck, a matching dark-brown ribbed long-sleeve knit top, and black high-waisted denim jeans. She winks playfully and makes a finger-heart gesture with her hand. Include red quilted leather car seats, dark interior trim, and blurred city lights through the window. Use soft warm cabin lighting, high-key facial illumination, cinematic shadows, a 35mm fashion-photography perspective, sharp subject focus, soft bokeh, vibrant but realistic browns and reds, and natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, celebrity likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: If supplied, use an approved adult face reference and preserve its facial structure, proportions, features, and expression. Preserve the chocolate hijab, matching knit top, finger-heart, wink, red quilted car seat, and warm night-cabin lighting. Do not use celebrity/public-figure likeness.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult while preserving the original hijab styling, gesture, luxury-car setting, and warm beauty portrait concept.
